title: Q8
description:
“When He again brings the firstborn into the world.”
Read: Exo 4:22, Psa 89:20–29
a) Psa 89:27 says: “I will make him My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.” What does that line add to “firstborn” here: birth order, or rank and inheritance?
b) Psa 89 is a psalm about the oath to David. What does the word “firstborn” bring with it from there into Hebrews?
